title: METER ASM & REAR HOSE
summary: Fuel tank gauge sending unit (fuel gauge sender / fuel meter) in the tank with its gasket and cam lock ring, the rear fuel hose from the sender outlet to the frame fuel line, and the vapor return hose from the tank vent fitting to the fuel vapor return line. The rear hose is held to the frame by a clip and screw; hoses are clamped at both ends; a clip holds the sender wire near the rear wiring harness.

fastening.note: Sending unit [6] goes into the tank opening on gasket [7]; cam lock ring [5] turns on over its flange to lock it.

fastening.to: sending unit [6] outlet tube and frame fuel line
fastening.note: Hose [3] runs from the sender outlet back along the frame to the fuel line; clamp [4] at each end (main view and View A).
View A: clip [2] wraps hose [3]; screw [8] goes through the clip into the frame side.

fastening.to: fuel tank vent pipe and fuel vapor return line
fastening.note: View A: hose [10] loops from the tank vent pipe down to the fuel vapor return line at the frame; clamp [9] at each end.

fastening.to: frame crossmember near the rear wiring harness
fastening.note: Clip [1] holds the sending unit lead where it runs up to the rear wiring harness.
